newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KLASCO HANDLES MORE CARGOES IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: KLASCO HANDLES MORE CARGOES IN MAY.

text.p: State run Klaipeda Stevedoring company (KLASCO), the biggest stevedoring firm in Lithuania, said on Tuesday it has handled 770,000 tonnes of cargo in May compared to 740,000 tonnes in April.
The company's director of commerce Egidijus Dagilis told Reuters that the main cargoes handled by the firm in May were metals and sugar.
"During five months of this year we handled the same amount of cargoes as in six months last year," Dagilis added.
The company said earlier it handled 7.5 million tonnes of cargo in 1996 and 2.294 million tonnes of cargo in the first quarter of this year.
Dagilis said the company was expecting reloading to slow down during the summer months but planned more intensive activity in the second half of September.
He also said the strengthening of two out of 14 quays was started in May which made the operation of the company more complicated.
The company is the most active loader in Klaipeda's port.
KLASCO is 90 percent state run and has been slated for privatisation via international bids in 1997-1998.
